regions.today: Mostly cloudy but dry for most, but the odd shower is possible. Light to moderate easterly winds.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry tonight with a mix of cloud, limited clear spells and a few light showers. Lowest temperatures of 2 to 6 degrees generally, though milder near coasts. Easterly winds will be mostly light, reaching moderate and occasionally fresh near coasts.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be another dry day for most with a mix of cloud, limited sunshine and just a few light showers. Moderate east to northeast winds will ease mostly light later in the day, with highest temperatures of 9 to 12 degrees.
